subject: Analytics
question:
Here x represents elapsed time and y represents speed. The graph shows Bart's speed while he is competing in a walking race. Which situation corresponds to the graph?
Choices:
A:Bart increases his speed for the first half of the race and then slows in the second half
B:Bart starts off by increasing his pace gradually and then maintains a constant speed
C:Bart starts off at a constant speed and then increases his speed at a steady rate
D:Bart increases his speed at a constant rate throughout the entire race

choices.A: Bart increases his speed for the first half of the race and then slows in the second half
choices.B: Bart starts off by increasing his pace gradually and then maintains a constant speed
choices.C: Bart starts off at a constant speed and then increases his speed at a steady rate
choices.D: Bart increases his speed at a constant rate throughout the entire race
